95
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the August 16, 2005/Sravana 25, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance;
Panchayati Raj; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Import of petroleum products
*301. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of petroleum products
imported by the country and the amount
spent thereon during each of the last three
years;
(b) the present need for the petroleum
products and the percentage of which is
met by the indigenous production;
(c) whether any fresh efforts are
proposed to be made by Government for
the exploration of oil so as to meet the
domestic demand for petroleum products
and to reduce the oil bill; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Action against AI officials
*302. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
two Air India traffic officers were
intercepted at the Heathrow Airport at
London in early June, 2005 with
contraband items from India and deported
back to Mumbai on account of their failure
to pay up the fine/penalty imposed by the
UK Customs;
(b) whether AI has taken appropriate
disciplinary action against the errant
officials; and
(c) whether Government will ensure
that the crew of our flag carriers flying to
overseas destinations are constantly drilled
to keep away from such unlawful
activities?
Post closure adjustment on
sale of PSUs
*303. SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to refer to answer to
Unstarred Question 1616 given in the
Rajya Sabha on the 6th March, 2003 and
state the details of post closure
adjustments, made in the case of BALCO,

96
Paradeep Phosphates, HTL, Jessop, ITDC
Hotels, Airport Hotels, IPCL, VSNL and
other cases of strategic sale of PSUs?
Non-payment of mediclaim by
insurance companies
†*304. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have received
complaints regarding non-payment of
mediclaim by the health insurance
companies;
(b) if so, the  steps being taken by
Government in this regard; and
(c) whether some companies have given
suggestions for its improvement?
Grants-in-aid to Gujarat
*305. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the share as tax devolution and
grants-in-aid to Gujarat as recommended
by the Tenth and Eleventh Finance
Commissions and what was the actual
disbursements made for 1995-2000 and
2000-2005;
(b) whether it is a fact that the actual
amount disbursed is less than that
recommended by respective Finance
Commissions; and
(c) the details of proposal received from
Gujarat for "State specific needs" for the
consideration  by Twelfth Finance
Commission and what is the
recommendation of the Twelfth Finance
Commission in respect thereof?
Bangalore International airport
project
*306. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is inordinate delay in
implementing the India's first greenfield,
corporate, joint sector airport of
international standard at Bangalore;
(b) if  so, the details in this regard; and
(c) the steps taken to hasten the process
of implementation of the Bangalore
International Airport?
Implementation of Dahej Urban
Pipeline
*307. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of progress made in the
implementation of the Dahej Urban
Pipeline, so far;
(b) how much gas is proposed to be
supplied to Maharashtra for feeding
industrial, power and other projects since
Maharashtra falls on the pipeline project
indicating the number and nature of the
projects to be fed; and
(c) whether Maharashtra Government
has laid its claim or otherwise requested
for additional gas supply; if so, the details
in this regard and Government's response
thereto?
Revision of listing norms by
SEBI
*308. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether in order to give relief to the

Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has
reviewed and revised the listing and delisting
norms:
(b) if so, the details of major changes
and modifications being so made including
the reasons for such changes; and
(c) the steps since taken in this
direction?
Revenue of States after
implementation of VAT

SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that various States
in the country have registered different rates
of increase in their revenue after
implementation of VAT;
(b) if so, the rate of increase recorded
by each of the States during the first quarter
of the ye

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the August 16, 2005/Sravana 25, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions —155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Use of secondary airfields
2194. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a fresh review has been made
to assess the available infrastructure and
capacity to accommodate all the aircrafts
which the domestic airlines have recently
ordered to augment their fleets; and
(b) if so, the results thereof, and the
details of plans drawn up, if any, to meet
the demands for accommodating additional
aircrafts, including putting into regular
operations some existing secondary airfields
which are in disuse or are partially utilized?
 Modernisation of Chhatrapati
Shivaji Terminal, Mumbai
2195. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a proposal for expansion
and modernisation of the Chhatrapati
Shivaji Air Terminal in Mumbai on BOT
basis, was submitted by the State
Government of Maharashtra in April 2004;
(b) if so, the details and the estimated
cost of the project;
(c) the progress made so far and at what
stage of consideration and approval the
matter stands at present;
(d) the reasons for the delay and the
cost escalation accrued to the project so
far; and
(e) by when, the same is likely to be
cleared?
 Cancellation of AI's flights
†2196. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India is
facing heavy paucity of aircrafts and pilots
and on account of this the flights have to be
cancelled off and on;
(b) if so, the No. of flights which have
been cancelled by the Air India during the
last six months;
(c) whether Government have taken any
steps to get over the paucity of aircrafts
and pilots; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

498
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
 Permission for air travel facility to
patients
2197. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether some airlines including
Indian Airlines do not encourage medical
patients from flying in their planes;
(b) whether DGCA has no policy or
plans to ensure that all airlines extend the
maximum possible assistance to medical
patients and old people;
(c) the details of private airlines which
have shown a great amount of callousness
and brutality in denying people a facility
to travel when they are sick; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
inform, warn and caution all airlines that
their should be no hurdles to sick or
handicapped people from flying on any
airlines they choose?
 Issues relating to restructuring of
Delhi and Mumbai airports
2198. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Law Ministry has been
asked to scrutinise documents relating to
financial transactions that are to be handed
to eight parties shortlisted for restructuring
of airports in Delhi and Mumbai ahead of
crucial meeting of empowered Group of
Ministers;
(b) whether the Ministry of Law has
given its clearance;
(c) if so, the details of the same;
(d) whether Group of Ministers have
considered these suggestions made by the
Law Minister;
(e) if so, by when the final decision will
be taken by Group of Ministers in this
regard; and
(f) by when work on modernisation of
airports will actually start?
 Facilities for domestic passengers at
Ahmedabad airport
†2199. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of passengers travelled
every month from Ahmedabad in Air India,
Indian Airlines and private company flights
during last five years; and
(b) the details of facilities which are
provided by the Airports Authority of India
on the airport for the domestic passengers?
 Bagdogra airport as an international
airport
2200. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any demand to turn Bagdogra airport into
an international airport, considering its
strategic location;
(b) if so, what is Government's reaction
on the proposal/demand; and

499

(c) what steps are being taken to develop
the airport so that it can serve more people?

Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) names of the metropolitan cities of
the country for which facility of regular
flight has been provided from the capital of
Chhattisgarh, Raipur;
(b) the names of the cities for which
regular flight has been provided during last
three years;

other than the cap
